name: Gene
oneLine: One stretch of DNA that holds the recipe for one product.
howItWorks: A gene starts after a promoter and ends at a stop signal. The polymerase copies it into mRNA. Change the gene and you change the protein.
deeper: The minimal cell JCVI-syn3.0 has 473 genes. When it was built, the job of about a third of them was unknown.
sizeComparison: a 300th the width of a hair
simplification: Genes are drawn as coloured bands. Real DNA looks the same all along.
